Title: Public preview: Disable network policy in AKS for migration

Body.Content:
You can now use AKS update to temporarily disable your network policy engine for two migration scenarios

  1. Migration to Azure CNI overlay – Migration to overlay was limited because network policy needed to be disabled before migration could take place.
  2. Migration to other network policy engines – You can now migrate to other network policy engines. (e.g. Calico to Cilium)

Learn more.
